description: Create a complete Overlay Alerts Library system - a library of .webm video alerts that the platform provides to creators. Features: real-time animated previews, plan-based access control (admin defines minimum plan per alert), individual purchase option for non-qualifying plans, admin management panel for uploading/managing alerts, download protection (prevent users from saving .webm files while still allowing OBS/TikTok Studio to render them).
steps: 1. Create a new DB schema table 'alert_overlays' in lib/db/src/schema/ with fields: id (text PK), name (text), description (text), previewUrl (text - URL to .webm file for preview), overlayUrl (text - the actual overlay URL), thumbnailUrl (text - static image thumbnail), category (text), minPlan (text - 'free'|'basic'|'pro'), price (integer - price in cents for individual purchase, 0 if included in plan), isActive (boolean), order (integer), createdAt (bigint). Export from lib/db/src/schema/index.ts.

2. Create a new DB schema table 'alert_overlay_purchases' in lib/db/src/schema/ with fields: id (text PK), userId (text), alertOverlayId (text), purchasedAt (bigint), paymentMethod (text). Export from index.ts.

3. Create backend route artifacts/api-server/src/routes/alert-overlays.ts with: GET /api/alert-overlays (list all active alerts, public), GET /api/alert-overlays/:id (single alert detail), POST /api/alert-overlays (admin - create alert), PATCH /api/alert-overlays/:id (admin - update alert), DELETE /api/alert-overlays/:id (admin - delete alert), POST /api/alert-overlays/:id/purchase (user - purchase individual alert), GET /api/alert-overlays/my-purchases (user - list purchased alerts). The GET endpoints should include a 'hasAccess' field computed from user plan + purchases.

4. Add .webm support to media uploads: Update artifacts/api-server/src/routes/media.ts to allow video/webm MIME type uploads (add to SAFE_EXTENSIONS and detectImageMime/detectVideoMime). Add a magic-byte check for WebM files (starts with 0x1A 0x45 0xDF 0xA3). Set a higher size limit for video files (100MB).

5. Create the frontend page artifacts/creatools/src/pages/alert-overlays-library.tsx: A beautiful library/gallery page showing all available alert overlays. Each item shows: an animated preview (playing the .webm in a loop, NOT ugly rectangles - use a <video> element with autoplay, loop, muted), the alert name, category badge, plan requirement badge. If the user's plan qualifies OR they purchased it, show the overlay URL (copiable). If not, show a lock icon with option to purchase individually or upgrade plan. Include category filter tabs. Apply download protection: use CSS pointer-events:none on video, disable right-click via onContextMenu, add controlsList='nodownload' to video elements.

6. Add the admin section for managing alert overlays in artifacts/creatools/src/pages/admin.tsx: Add a new tab 'Alertas Overlay' in the admin panel. Show a table/grid of all alerts with ability to: upload new .webm files (using the media upload endpoint), set name/description/category, set minimum plan (free/basic/pro), set individual purchase price, toggle active/inactive, reorder. Include a preview of the .webm in the admin view.

7. Register the new route in artifacts/api-server/src/routes/index.ts and add the new page route in artifacts/creatools/src/App.tsx. Add navigation entry in app-layout.tsx DEFAULT_SECTIONS under the 'main' section overlays children or as a new item in FERRAMENTAS.

8. Add CSS-based download protection in the overlay pages: When the .webm is served in OBS/TikTok Studio as a browser source it works normally (transparent background, autoplay). But in the regular browser context, add: no right-click on video elements, no download attribute, Content-Disposition: inline header from the API, disable drag, use blob URLs where possible to make direct download harder.
acceptance_criteria: New DB tables alert_overlays and alert_overlay_purchases are defined and exported
Backend CRUD routes for alert overlays work (admin create/update/delete, user list/purchase)
Frontend library page shows .webm previews as actual animated video elements (not rectangles)
Plan-based access control: locked alerts show preview but not the overlay URL
Individual purchase option available for locked alerts when user has an active paid plan
Admin can upload and manage alert overlays from the admin panel
Download protection applied (no right-click, no download button, inline disposition)
